landing.title: Daleel
landing.tagline: An AI training coach for competitive programmers.
landing.description: Paste a Codeforces or AtCoder problem and your C++ code. Daleel finds where it breaks, proves it with a failing test, and teaches the fix through a hint ladder, without spoiling the solution.
landing.status: Early preview: the coach is under construction.

ladder_fallback_1.title: Check the boundaries
ladder_fallback_1.body: Try the smallest allowed values by hand. Which part of your code decides the answer?

ladder_fallback_2.title: Revisit the constraints
ladder_fallback_2.body: Compare the problem's requirements with the assumptions in your approach. Does each assumption hold for every allowed value?

ladder_fallback_3.title: Trace your own lines
ladder_fallback_3.body: Follow your code step by step on a small case. Compare each decision with the statement and check where they disagree.

ladder_fallback_4.title: Review the reasoning
ladder_fallback_4.body: Write down why each step should work, then check the boundaries and time complexity. Change only the lines that do not match that reasoning.
